_comment: Extra build_geometry.py flags per plan version. The ONE source for both the manual build (build_version.py) and Edit AI's rebuild (edit_ai.py VERSIONS). Change a version's flags here only, then rebuild with: ~/.dwg-tools/bin/python build_version.py <version>. kareems-changes' last --cut carves off the 0.32 m block build_geometry's corner-square step adds to the reception column (DWG face x 207.9471 = plan 17.542); without it the column re-inflates to 17.862 (Edit AI 0a5a7de, 25 Oct 2026). Locked by design-locks.json kc-column-face.
